description.zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
description.en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English.
The namespace (environment) of Application High Availability Service (AHAS).
Specifies whether AHAS is deployed in the Internet region.

description.zh: 迁移后目标 mse 应用名。未填写的情况下默认和 ahas 应用名一致。
description.en: The name of the MSE application after migration. If this parameter is not specified, the name of the Application High Availability Service (AHAS) application is used by default.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse clone-sentinel-rule-from-ahas --namespace default --mse-app-name spring-cloud-a --app-name spring-cloud-a --ahas-namespace default --is-ahas-public-region false --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse CloneSentinelRuleFromAhas --region cn-hangzhou --MseAppName 'spring-cloud-a' --AhasNamespace default --IsAHASPublicRegion false --AcceptLanguage zh --Namespace default --AppName 'spring-cloud-a'
